questions.stem: Which scenario best represents complex problem solving?
choices: An evolving system with interacting variables, incomplete information and competing goals
A routine task with no feedback
A task that excludes human judgment
questions.explanation: Complex problems can combine dynamic interdependencies, limited transparency and conflicting objectives.

questions.stem: What do Fahrbach and Fust (2026) propose for developing complex-problem-solving expertise?
choices: Combine planning, monitoring and evaluation with metacognitive and motivational regulation
Assume their conceptual framework proves universal effectiveness
questions.explanation: Their theoretical paper proposes self-regulated learning strategies; it does not establish a universal causal training effect.
